newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shin-Etsu Chemical up on earnings, share repurchase.
newsitem.headline: Shin-Etsu Chemical up on earnings, share repurchase.

text.p: Shin-Etsu Chemical Co Ltd shares strengthened in early Monday morning trade due to solid earnings and a share repurchase plan both announced late last week, brokers said.

As of 0015 GMT, the shares of the semiconductor silicon and PVC producer were up 40 yen at 2,630. It was the fifth most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse with 645,000 shares traded.
On Friday, Shin-Etsu said its parent current profit in the year to March 31 was 25.80 billion yen, compared with 22.15 billion in the previous business year.
The firm also said it would buy back 722,000 of its own shares at a cost not exceeding 2.5 billion yen, to introduce a stock option scheme.
